info.title: Coldreach API
info.description: The Coldreach public API allows you to programmatically access your campaigns, accounts, and analytics.

get.description: Verify that your API key is valid and you are authenticated.

post.description: Send a reply to a contact assignment in a sequence. The recipient email is auto-derived from the contact if not provided.

post.description: Upserts contacts into a campaign with pre-written snippet values. By default, existing contact data is updated and ineligible contacts are skipped. Set existingContactPolicy to preserve to assign a known contact without changing its persisted data. Use bypass flags to selectively override specific eligibility rules.

requestBody.description: Contacts to upsert with variable values and eligibility options

existingContactPolicy.description: Whether existing contact data should be updated from the request or preserved unchanged.

200.description: Upsert result with counts, skipped contacts, and any errors

skippedContacts.description: Contacts that were skipped due to ineligibility, with reasons
Contacts that were skipped due to ineligibility, with reasons

404.description: Campaign not found or has no sequences

post.summary: Check contact eligibility for a campaign
post.description: Check whether contacts are eligible to be added to a campaign's sequence. Returns per-contact eligibility status with reasons for ineligibility (cooldown, already in another sequence, replied, blocked, or globally excluded). Use this before upserting contacts to avoid adding ineligible ones.

requestBody.description: List of emails to check eligibility for
